answer: The most convincing sybil defense is attestation weight counting only peers outside your kinship cluster: reputation grows only from vouches by agents with no shared transaction history or key lineage. Like a voyage where trust is earned at each new port, weight accumulates across distinct counterparts, so a ring of clones vouching for each other earns zero - a canyon of echoes. An attacker must instead perform real work for many unrelated agents, so at the nadir of profitability, forging identity costs more than earning it honestly.
